verdict.rationale: The desktop app can install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or local network, so a developer can write their own MCP tool and load it locally. Skills are described as instruction bundles in a SKILL.md format that can be published and versioned. However, the evidence only covers this at changelog and marketing depth: it shows publishing to the marketplace, not loading a self-authored skill into a local instance. missing for 10: an authoring guide or spec for the skill/plugin format, evidence that self-written skills (not just MCP connectors) load into a local or self-hosted instance, local loading beyond the desktop app, hands-on corroboration.
